description: Checks a calculation certificate issued by ניירת (returned as "certificate" by wage_ledger, claim_quantification, judgment_interest): recomputes the answer from the input you send with the engine and the dataset loaded now, and checks every hash (certificate intact, input matches, engine version, dataset, CPI and interest tables, output byte-identical). Use it to prove that a figure in a claim or report was computed under the stated rules. Nothing is stored.

input.description: The exact input (arguments) the certificate was issued for

name: verify_certificate
title: Verify a ניירת calculation certificate
